approach: Add one lexical reading check, `check_environment_reach(reading)`, in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, modelled on `check_code_survey` (reading.rs:3910) and registered as one `step!` line after `check_outcome_state` in `refusing_check` (reading.rs:3248). This revision narrows the triggers to places where a reading assigns an action. (1) A deliverable that creates or modifies a file under `.github/workflows/`. (2) A Behavior criterion that holds an action phrase: git push, a push verb followed by origin/remote/upstream/branch/ref, fetch/clone/pull from origin/remote, open/create a pull request, or `gh` followed by a command word. (3) A Behavior criterion or the summary that names a records or history source (job records, job history, commit history, git history, git log, records branch, `athena/records`) after a source verb such as from, in, using, counts, measures, replays, queries. Content criteria, assumptions, out_of_scope, the request text and backticked spans are never scanned. Path-like and identifier tokens (containing `/`, `_`, `::` or an inner `.`) are dropped before phrase matching. This keeps `gh/early.rs`, `parse_remote`, `remote.rs` and 'entries are pushed onto the list' from triggering. A triggered reading needs one `Environment:` assumption with a site word, a permission word and a data word. A host action also needs a no/without/missing origin case. A records or history source also needs a counted figure (a 1–5 digit number or percent directly before a counted noun, such as '3 jobs', '12 readings', '40%') or a reachable file path that is not under records/ or athena/records. The gate returns Ok when capability is None, a question is set, or the deliverable list is empty (as `check_governance_coverage` does at reading.rs:3316). The doc comment, CHANGELOG entry, reader brief rule line and corpus cases are as in the earlier plan, with the 8% share labelled an estimate and its basis stated.

decisions.choice: Scan only Behavior criteria (host-action and records-source phrases), the summary (records-source phrases only), and deliverable paths (workflows). Content criteria, assumptions, out_of_scope and the request are not scanned.
decisions.reason: Finding 1: a content criterion that names a word assigns no action or measurement. Behavior criteria are the ones that must be run, so they are where an action runs somewhere. `CriterionKind` has only Content and Behavior (athena-data records.rs:64), so the split is exact. A workflow deliverable is a real CI assignment, so it is read from the deliverable list. The assumptions are skipped so the `Environment:` repair text cannot trigger its own check.

rejected.option: Scan every criterion with bare-word triggers (earlier plan)
rejected.why: Fires on mentions such as `crates/athena-core/src/gh/early.rs`, `parse_remote` and 'entries are pushed onto the list', and makes a docs or refactor reading write a 'no origin' sentence.
A request can mention push without the reading assigning it. The reading's own criteria and deliverables are where the action is assigned.

decisions.choice: Normalise criterion text before matching. Remove backticked spans. Split on whitespace and trim punctuation. Drop any raw token containing `/`, `_`, `::` or an interior `.` and put a break marker in its place. Keep the single token `athena/records` as a source word. Lowercase, split the rest on non-alphanumerics into words, then match phrases over adjacent words.
decisions.reason: Finding 1 (2). This removes module paths (`gh/`, `remote.rs`), identifiers (`parse_remote`) and the slash-joined 'push/pull-request/gh' of this job's own criterion 3, so none of them count. The break marker stops a phrase from spanning a dropped token. Phrases are bounded windows: push verb within 4 words before origin/remote/upstream/branch/branches/ref/refs, or `git` then `push`; fetch/fetches/fetched/clone/clones/cloned/pull/pulls/pulled within 3 words before origin/remote/upstream; open/opens/opened/opening/create/creates/created within 3 words before `pull request(s)`; `git remote`; `gh` followed directly by pr, api, run, auth, workflow, release or issue. A Vec push, 'pushed onto the list' and a bare `gh` word therefore do not match.

rejected.option: Whole-token match on push, origin, remote, gh
rejected.why: Splitting identifiers and paths into tokens makes `gh/early.rs` yield `gh` and `parse_remote` yield `remote`.

decisions.choice: Records-source trigger (case B) needs a source verb within 3 words before the phrase: from, in, using, uses, counts, measures, replays, queries, parses, scans. It applies to Behavior criteria and the summary only.
decisions.reason: This job's own criterion 4 says 'a reading citing job records, history or the records branch as a source'. 'citing' and 'reading' are not in the verb list, so the criterion does not trigger. The producer pins this job's criterion 3 and 4 texts as accept fixtures. The nm0k shape ('Use figures from job records and history') and the engm shape ('reads the job records on the records branch') do trigger. The summary is read for B only because job nm0k cited records in its summary. The actual summary of this job is not in the brief, so the producer must run the check on it if it is available; the lists are tuned by adding corpus cases, never by weakening the check.

rejected.option: Fire on any mention of records or history
rejected.why: 'records validation', `AnyRecord` and 'history of the page' are common and are not reads of unreachable data.

decisions.choice: A quoted figure is a number of 1–5 digits (or a `NN%` token) immediately followed by a counted noun: job(s), reading(s), commit(s), record(s), run(s), plan(s), introspection(s), attempt(s), case(s), ref(s), branch(es), file(s), percent or `%`. A bare year or '2 refs' with no cited source does not qualify as evidence unless the noun follows. The figure must be in the same `Environment:` assumption as the source word. A reachable file is a raw token with a .md/.json/.jsonl/.txt/.csv/.toml/.rs/.yml/.yaml extension not starting with `records/` or `athena/records`.
decisions.reason: Finding 5. 'sees main as of 2026' has no counted noun and is refused. '3 jobs, 12 readings' and '40%' are accepted. 6- and 8-digit job-id parts are not figures. The requirement that the assumption also holds a source word (records, history, log) ties the figure to the cited source.

rejected.why: A year or a count of refs would pass with no records figure quoted.

decisions.choice: Gate on capability, question and an empty deliverable list: return Ok when capability is None, a question is set, or `deliverables` is empty.
decisions.reason: Finding 3. This matches `check_governance_coverage` (reading.rs:3316). A reading with no deliverables changes nothing and assigns no action; the criterion 6 test uses only a decline, a question and a no-deliverable reading with no trigger text, not 'a no-deliverable reading with a push criterion'.

rejected.option: Keep the earlier gating and test a no-deliverable reading with a push criterion
rejected.why: The planned accept case would fail against that gating.

decisions.choice: Place `step!(check_environment_reach(reading));` directly after `step!(check_outcome_state(reading, request));` and give the workflow corpus cases both the `.github/workflows/...` Create deliverable and a criterion that names it.
decisions.reason: Finding 2. `check_governance_coverage` runs earlier and refuses a workflow deliverable that no criterion names (reading.rs:3326-3331). The cases change more than one field of `base_reading` (refusal_corpus.rs:117): the deliverable and a content criterion naming the workflow path. The producer asserts the refuse case is refused by `check_environment_reach` and not `check_governance_coverage`. The request text must not name a governance path, so governance is not triggered by the request. The position after outcome_state keeps `check_outcome_state_doc_names_root_cause_and_scope` (reading.rs:7725) and the corpus anchor `step!(check_reading_references(` unchanged.

rejected.why: It would break the 'delivery-request-naming-a-workflow-fails-governance-first' ordering and the test that pins outcome_state right after governance.

decisions.choice: Declare the share as 'expected 8% of newly refused readings', labelled an estimate that was not measured, with its basis. The criterion text from the brief fixes the 8%. The doc comment and CHANGELOG state: no records are in the snapshot to replay; 11 lines of HISTORY.txt name `.github/workflows`, which bounds the workflow trigger at roughly 5% of 200 commits; the host-action and records-source triggers add a small allowance. The replay hold is the declared share plus `REPLAY_DECLARED_MARGIN_POINTS` (5), so it holds at 13%.
decisions.reason: Finding 1 says the 8% had no basis. The narrowed triggers shrink the real share, and the figure is now stated as an estimate with its source. The producer is told not to present it as a measurement.

rejected.why: Nothing was measured; the snapshot has no records.

decisions.choice: Pin the declaration in the CHANGELOG by cutting out the new entry (from the line holding 'no step asking who performs each action' to the next line that starts `- ` or `#`) and asserting every needle inside that slice only.
decisions.reason: Finding 4. 'higher refusal rate is intended' already appears in earlier entries, so a whole-file search proves nothing. The doc comment is cut the same way as `code_survey_refusal_is_declared_intended` (reading.rs:9142), splitting at `pub fn check_environment_reach`.

decisions.choice: Keep the rest of the earlier design: label `Environment:` matched after trim in any case; completeness by fixed word lists for site (ci, runner, workflow, producer, snapshot, local, host, github, reader, verifier), permission (read, reads, write, writes, readonly, permission, permissions) and data (refs, ref, branch, branches, records, history, files, repo, repository, checkout, data, commits, logs, figures); no schema, table or prompt file; one rule line in `READING_RULES` in briefs.rs.
decisions.reason: Same as before: no record schema change (`deny_unknown_fields`), no model call, and the reader brief is outside the budgeted prompt sets (docs/system-facts.md 'Prompt sets and budgets'), so budget lines do not move.

rejected.option: Add an `environment` field to Reading or a capabilities table file
rejected.why: Changes the record schema or adds a data file; both are out of scope.

rejected.option: Judge the assumption with a model call
rejected.why: Adds cost and nondeterminism to a gate that runs no model today, and is hard to pin in a corpus.

risks.risk: The lexical triggers still miss real actions (a push described in other words) or catch a prose mention in a Behavior criterion. The 8% share is an estimate.
risks.mitigation: Triggers are limited to Behavior criteria, the summary for records sources, and deliverable paths. They need a verb-plus-target phrase and skip backticked, path-like and identifier tokens. The accept tests cover `gh/early.rs`, `parse_remote`, a Vec push, 'entries are pushed onto the list', 'originates' and this job's own criteria. The doc and changelog label 8% as an estimate with its basis (11 lines of HISTORY.txt name `.github/workflows`; no records to replay). Lists are tuned by adding corpus cases, never by weakening the check.

risks.risk: This job's own accepted summary (not shown in the brief) may hold a source phrase and be newly refused.
risks.mitigation: The source trigger needs a source verb before the phrase, and the producer runs the check on the summary text if it is given; otherwise the lists are adjusted by adding a case. The summary's wording 'unreachable records' has no 'job records' or history phrase.

risks.risk: The lexical word lists can be satisfied by a wrong sentence.

risks.mitigation: Workflow cases add the Create deliverable and a criterion naming it so `check_governance_coverage` passes; the request text names no governance path; accept cases use only docs/guide.md and docs/design/roadmap.md from `repo_files()`. The producer checks each refuse case names `check_environment_reach`.

The line: 'Environment: an action on CI, a push or pull request, or a source in job records or history needs an `Environment:` assumption naming site, read/write permissions and data it reaches (`check_environment_reach`).' is within 220 bytes.

risks.risk: The new text trips the boundary scan (banned words about who runs Athena) or the personal-data allow-list.

Refuse cases: (i) a Create deliverable `.github/workflows/lint.yml` plus a criterion that names it, so governance passes, and no `Environment:` assumption; the refusing check is `check_environment_reach` and the error starts 'the reading was refused because' and names site, permissions and data. (ii) One Behavior criterion each, with no `Environment:`: 'Athena pushes the job branch to origin', 'The pull request is opened with `gh pr create`', 'A pull request is opened on the remote', 'The job branch is pushed to the remote'; all refused. (iii) The same readings with a complete assumption ('Environment: the local Athena process has write access to the working copy; with no origin or a non-GitHub origin it skips the push; with a GitHub origin it can push refs and open a pull request'): `refusing_check` is None. (iv) An assumption missing the permission word is refused and the error names 'permissions'. (v) The label matches after trim and in any case; an assumption that only mentions the word 'environment' does not count. (vi) A host-action reading whose assumption lacks the no-origin case is refused. (vii) A Delete of a workflow does not trigger.
demonstrations.observes: Readings with a workflow deliverable or a push/pull-request/gh action in a Behavior criterion and no complete `Environment:` assumption are refused by `check_environment_reach`. The same readings with such an assumption give `refusing_check` None.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the `step!` line removed, `refusing_check` returns None for the refused readings and the assertions that the refusing check is `check_environment_reach` fail. With the label or word lists wrong, the accept assertions fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points `refusing_check` and `check_environment_reach` (new, plan step 2) called directly. Fixtures are `Reading` values from `governed_reading` and `add_behavior` (exist, read at reading.rs:7364 and 7505), plus a `with_environment` helper added in plan step 3. No test double is used.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests `environment_reach_source_*` in reading.rs. Three readings shaped like the three jobs, each also run through `refusing_check` so the refusing check's name is asserted. (engm) A code-class reading with a `Code survey:` assumption naming a crates/ path (so `check_code_survey` passes) and a Behavior criterion 'The history check reads the job records on the records branch': refused with no Environment assumption; refused with a complete assumption that has no figure or file (the error says to quote the figures inline or name a reachable file); accepted with 'Environment: the CI job has read-only contents and cannot write the records branch; it sees 3 jobs and 12 readings'. (8ra0) the push/origin/pull-request reading of criterion 3, accepted only when the no-origin case is stated. (nm0k) A docs reading whose summary says 'Use the figures from job records and history': refused; accepted when the assumption quotes '3 jobs' inline; accepted when it lists `docs/design/roadmap.md`; refused when the only file listed is `records/foo.json` or `athena/records/x.json`. Refused when the only number is a bare year ('Environment: CI job, read-only, sees main as of 2026'). A loop covers every B phrase (job records, job history, commit history, git history, git log, records branch, `athena/records`), each with a source verb. A source phrase without a source verb ('a reading citing job records') is not a trigger.
demonstrations.observes: A reading citing records or history as a source is refused unless the figures are quoted inline next to a counted noun or a reachable file is listed, and it is accepted when they are. Three differently shaped readings are covered, so the class is tested and not one job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the step, `refusing_check` returns None for the refused readings and the name assertions fail. Without the figure/file rule, the 'complete but nothing quoted' reading and the bare-year reading are wrongly accepted.

demonstrations.method: Refusal corpus. Plan step 4 adds cases to `reading_check_cases()` in crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs with `case(..)` and `base_reading` (exist, refusal_corpus.rs:57-206). Refuse cases (`Expected::Refuse("check_environment_reach")`): `environment-ci-workflow-without-an-environment` (deliverable `.github/workflows/lint.yml` Create plus a content criterion naming it, so governance passes), `environment-host-action-without-an-environment` (Behavior criterion 'Athena pushes the job branch to origin'), `environment-records-source-without-figures` (Behavior criterion that reads the job records on the records branch). Accept cases: `environment-ci-workflow-with-an-environment`, `environment-host-action-with-origin-cases`, `environment-records-source-with-quoted-figures`, `environment-records-source-with-a-reachable-file`, `environment-trigger-words-only-inside-other-words` (criteria: 'fixed where it originates', a `gh/early.rs` path, a `parse_remote` identifier, 'entries are pushed onto the list', a Vec push), `environment-gh-module-path-only`, `environment-bare-year-environment` (refuse; Environment names only a year). `environment_reach_refusal_is_declared_intended` pins the step line, the doc comment and the changelog entry, as `design_existing_code_refusal_is_declared_intended` does (refusal_corpus.rs:1102). Input forms: workflow deliverable Create/Modify (new cases above) and Delete (reading.rs unit test); push, pull-request and gh phrases (refuse cases); slash-joined or identifier tokens such as `push/pull-request/gh`, `gh/early.rs`, `parse_remote` (accept case); records source with a figure, a file, a records-only file, a bare year; dash and star request bullets are carried by `base_reading`, which turns request bullets into content criteria, so the Behavior-criterion cases set the criterion kind on the reading, not the request; existing ids read in the file include code-reading-without-a-survey, code-reading-with-a-survey, design-reading-without-existing-code, design-reading-with-existing-code, request-names-a-governance-file-the-reading-ignores, delivery-request-naming-a-workflow-fails-governance-first, boundary-word-in-a-deliverable-path, full-deliverable-path. New form tags are added to `INPUT_FORMS` (array length raised to match).

demonstrations.method: Unit tests `environment_reach_accepts_*` in reading.rs plus the corpus accept cases. A plain docs reading (`governed_reading(&["docs/x.md"], &["docs/x.md exists"], &[])`) passes `check_environment_reach` and `refusing_check` is None. Accepted with no `Environment:`: content criteria naming push, origin, `gh/early.rs`, `parse_remote`, 'entries are pushed onto the list', 'the history of the page', 'fixed where it originates'; Behavior criteria containing only 'ghost', 'pushdown', 'remotely', 'Vec push'; this job's own criteria 3 and 4 texts, copied from the brief; a reading with a push phrase in an assumption or in out_of_scope only; a decline (capability None); a reading with a question; a reading with no deliverables and a push phrase in a Behavior criterion. The 8% estimate is pinned by the criterion 1 and 5 declaration tests.
demonstrations.observes: Docs-only readings and readings without an assigned action or a records source are accepted. Mentions of the words in paths, identifiers, content criteria and other words do not trigger.
demonstrations.fails_without: With substring or bare-token triggers, 'originates', `gh/early.rs` and `parse_remote` would be refused and the accept tests would fail. Without the capability, question and empty-deliverable gating, the decline, question and no-deliverable readings would be refused.
